notes:
SETUP INSTRUCTIONS:

1. IMPORT THIS FILE: n8n → Settings → Import Workflow → select this file

2. SET EMAIL CREDENTIAL:
   - Click the 'Send Thank-You Email' node
   - Under Credential, select your existing email credential
   - Update 'fromEmail' to your actual sending address

3. GET YOUR WEBHOOK URL:
   - Click the 'Stripe Webhook' node
   - Copy the webhook URL shown (e.g. https://your-n8n.com/webhook/lcermf-donation)

4. ADD WEBHOOK IN STRIPE:
   - Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → Add endpoint
   - URL: paste your webhook URL from step 3
   - Event: checkout.session.completed

5. ACTIVATE: Toggle the workflow to Active

6. ADD STRIPE PAYMENT LINKS to js/app.js:
   - Stripe Dashboard → Payment Links → New
   - Create one link per amount for both One-Time and Monthly
   - Paste URLs into STRIPE_LINKS in js/app.js
